title: Claude Tag alternative: pi-durable-bot (Pots), open source
description: An open-source alternative to Claude Tag: pi-durable-bot (Pots) also reads the channel and decides when to act, but runs on your machine with any model.
claim: Claude Tag and pi-durable-bot (Pots) both read the channel and decide when to act. Pots is open source, runs on any machine you choose, and works with any model.
answer: Pots is an open-source AI coworker that decides when to act and works on its own computer. Claude Tag is Anthropic's Claude in Slack; it also reads untagged messages and decides itself whether to act. The differences are open source, self-hosting and model choice.

rivalIs.text: Claude Tag puts Claude in Slack as a team member that anyone in a channel can tag. By default it also reads untagged messages and decides for each one whether to reply, offer help or start work. Each thread runs in a sandbox on Anthropic's infrastructure; it is a public beta for Team and Enterprise.

table.note: Claude Tag cells: Anthropic's public pages, checked 2026-11-10. Your data: with a local model for the agent and the judge, nothing leaves your machine; with a hosted model, requests go to the provider you chose.

rows.pots: Yes. Gateway, agent, log and memory on your machine
rows.rival: No. Runners execute in your network; control plane and conversation go to Anthropic

pickRival: Your team works in Slack and has Claude Team or Enterprise.
You want Anthropic to host it, with no machine to keep.
You want admin controls: channel access, spend limits, an action log.
You want a fresh sandbox per thread, outbound traffic denied by default.
pickPots: You want the source code, under MIT.
You want all of it on your machine, not only the runners.
You want any model, including a local one.

faq.q: Does Claude Tag read messages that do not tag it?
faq.a: Yes. By default it reads messages in its channels, tagged or not, and decides for each whether to act; a mention only guarantees a reply.
Partly. Team and Enterprise can run sessions on self-hosted runners (public beta), but the control plane, the conversation and, by default, model inference still go to Anthropic.
Yes. `pots login` can sign in with a Claude subscription or an API key; any other model pi supports works too.

No. The other products as their makers described them in public, checked 2026-11-10; they may have changed since. Grok Bot, dots, Claude Duet, Claude Tag and Muse are products of SpaceXSI, OpenAI, Anthropic and Meta. pi-durable-bot is not affiliated with any of them.
